content_of_post_to_answer: What research methods are useful for mental health assignment writing?
answer: For mental health assignments, the best research method depends on the question you are trying to answer. A literature review can reveal patterns across existing studies, while surveys, interviews, and case studies can explore lived experiences. A common mistake is collecting information without evaluating its quality. In mental health research, the method shapes the story you are able to tell, so choosing the right method is as important as finding the right sources.
